language.heading: Interface language
language.description: Choose the language openDox is displayed in for you. The setting applies on all your devices.
language.label: Language

dictionary.heading: My dictionaries
dictionary.description: Your own term lists for the automatic medical term correction, for example for testing. They apply automatically to all your recordings, whatever the category.

categories.heading: My categories
categories.description: Create and manage your own categories for your recordings. They are only visible to you, in addition to the globally provided categories. You do not need to attach your own dictionaries, they always apply.

appearance.heading: Appearance
appearance.description: Light, dark, or matching your operating system.
